name: preview_revert
description: Read-only WOULD-restore preview for revert_document (never mutates: no revision bump, no disk write, no redo-stack change). Target one commit: {steps:N} walks back N saved commits from the head (1 = the previous saved commit, must be < totalCommits) OR {commitOid:"<40-hex>"} jumps to that commit (mutually exclusive). Returns {ok:true,sessionId,targetOid,targetMessage,targetAuthor,stepsBack,affectedFiles,changedValues,changedValuesTruncated,changedValuesPositional,dirty,dirtyHandling,currentHeadOid,totalCommits} where affectedFiles lists package paths that differ from the target (word/document.xml plus tracked extras). The preview also carries advisory changedValues [{nodeId,before,after}] (live current text -> target restore text, bounded: at most 20 entries, each side at most 200 chars, truncated flag honest; changedValuesPositional:true means either side held orphan ids (no shared id across the boundary, common under duplicate native ids) so before/after pairing is positional, not identity; empty + changedValuesReason when the target range is not computable). Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc","steps":1} -> preview summary. Preview first when a revert would discard unsaved edits.
